refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: For vectors, RMS(X) is the root mean squared value in X. For matrices, RMS(X) is a row vector containing the RMS value from each column. For N-D arrays, RMS(X) operates along the first non-singleton dimension.
Y = RMS(X,DIM) operates along the dimension DIM.
When X is complex, the RMS is computed using the magnitude RMS(ABS(X)).
